# World Bank MCP Server

Global development indicators covering GDP, inflation, trade, debt, population, and more for 200+ countries. No key required for basic usage.

## Key Indicators

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| NY.GDP.MKTP.CD | GDP (current USD) |
| NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG | GDP growth (annual %) |
| NY.GDP.PCAP.CD | GDP per capita |
| FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG | Inflation (CPI, annual %) |
| SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS | Unemployment rate |
| BN.CAB.XOKA.GD.ZS | Current account balance (% GDP) |
| GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS | Central government debt (% GDP) |
| BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS | Foreign direct investment (% GDP) |
| NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS | Exports (% GDP) |
| SP.POP.TOTL | Population |
